method: For each strategy, fit actual recovered proxy score = intercept + slope * expected lineup score on earlier fully scored rounds only. Calibration begins after 20 previous rounds, slope clipped to [0,2], and is used only to forecast the next round score; lineups are unchanged.
limitations: Outcome scores include explicit zero candidates and are not certified official actuals.
Historical coach credit multipliers and transfer malus are still proxies.
This calibrates expected score after selection; it does not correct which players the optimizer selected.
